ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a very low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips and specular reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark contiguous region covering the majority of the fluke; small, high-contrast white clusters are localized exclusively at the far-left and far-right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse angle (~115 degrees) and moderate vertical depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with more pronounced jaggedness near the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, irregularly shaped pixel clusters at the distal ends of both lobes; scattered circular high-intensity spots on the central fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacle colonization) on the left and right tips; minor edge irregularities suggesting prior physical impact on the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high pigmentation level (consistent with Type 1 classification) with no significant white mottling on the main ventral surface.
